name: Snap
description: A log that blinks.

name: Fleece
description: Too tall for the ferns, and knows it.

name: Bramble
description: Honey on his breath.

name: Pond
description: A bench that breathes.

name: Moth
description: Watching the boar like a job.

name: Pip
description: Feet in the mud, head in the sky.

name: Clover
description: The spotted one. A slow blink.

name: Butter
description: The plain one. Also a slow blink.

name: Fern
description: Gone if you look straight at her.

name: Burr
description: Follows the bridges. Does not help.

name: Thistle
description: Will not cross until he decides.

name: Puddle
description: Claims every marsh.

name: Boulder
description: The plants lean out of the way.

name: Rust
description: A tail where a flower was.

name: Cliff
description: Standing where the grass ends.

name: Seed
description: Cheeks full of something.

name: Pin
description: A bush that rustles back.

name: Reed
description: One ear on the wind.

name: Hop
description: Two bounds, then a stare.

name: Sun
description: Asleep until the bridge creaks.

name: Vine
description: Already on the next island.

name: Bamboo
description: Sitting. That is the whole plan.

name: Pebble
description: Far from any ice, and fine.

name: Truffle
description: A cousin. Do not mention it.

name: Snow
description: White fur in the green shade.

name: Nibble
description: Still, then not.

name: Whisk
description: Along the plank, under the plank.

name: Knob
description: The horn finds the ferns first.

name: Splash
description: On the grass like it is a rock.

name: Cloud
description: A shrub that wandered off.

name: Cache
description: Buried it. Forgot where.

name: Stripe
description: The grass has extra shadows.
